iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

NAME_RESOLVED
       Deprecated: Triggered after a NAME::lookup command has been issued and a response has been received.

DESCRIPTION
       This event is triggered after a NAME__lookup command has been issued and a response has been received. This response could
       be either a success or a failure.

Examples
	when HTTP_REQUEST {
	    NAME::lookup [HTTP::host]
	}

	when NAME_RESOLVED {
	    node [NAME::response] 80

	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-9.0.0 --First introduced the event.  @BIGIP-15.1.0 --Deprecated in favor of RESOLVER and DNSMSG namespaces

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
